messages:
Sam (docs): Heads-up — opened PR #642 to reorganize the dashboard how-to pages and sweep dead links. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/642
Mira Patel: Thanks — quick question: are we removing the old `kv-cache` example or just replacing it?
Sam (docs): Replacing. New example shows prefix + KV caching patterns for python & node; kept the old call as a commented alt for legacy users.
Joël: I skimmed the draft — the code block in `console/dashboards/kv_cache.md` still has a stray `<` on one line. I can push a tiny patch.
Sam (docs): Please do. Also want to reorder the cost breakdown section so latency is above cost (makes more sense for the UX flow).
Tomas: I can retake the dashboard screenshot to reflect the new ordering and upload it to the PR tonight.
docs-bot: lint results for PR #642 — 3 warnings, 1 broken link: /docs/obs/old-kv-example -> 404
Mira Patel: That broken link is the one I flagged earlier. I prepared a redirect, but we need infra/eng to add it to the redirect table.
Joël: For consistency, can the redirect target `/docs/observability/kvcache-example`? Keeps the path structure tidy.
Sam (docs): yes, target that. Also add a short note about `batch_size` defaults — folks have been surprised by cost spikes when they increase it.
Mira Patel: I'll add a quick paragraph and a tiny inline example showing cost vs latency tradeoffs. No tables, just two bullets + example snippet.
Tomas: Uploaded the new screenshot and added descriptive alt text. PR has a new commit.
Joël: Pushed the char fix and adjusted the python snippet to use `client.kv_cache(prefix=...)` and handle TTL edge case.
Sam (docs): Two remaining items before merge: (1) changelog entry under docs/changes/2026-03.md, (2) add this PR to the release-docs board. I'll handle both after CI.
Mira Patel: Preview build finished and passed ✅ — waiting on redirect merge.
docs-bot: deploy-preview built — https://deploy-preview-642--docs.redwood.ai
Sam (docs): Once the redirect is in, I'll merge. Thanks everyone for the quick fixes :tada:
